proposed_tasks.name: 帮我比较这几个岗位机会，看哪个最值得现在投入
proposed_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 机会比较
proposed_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望把自己指定的几个真实机会按自己关心的标准比较，得到现阶段最值得优先投递或重点准备的建议和理由。
user_request_examples: 帮我比较这几个岗位，看哪个最值得现在投
这几个机会里我想选一个重点准备，帮我比一比
我拿不定主意，帮我把这些岗位的条件列出来比一下
根据我的情况，这几个机会哪个优先级更高？
proposed_tasks.decision_reason: 需要把用户自选标准、机会事实、用户背景和既有投递优先级放在一起权衡并给出推荐理由，是决策型综合判断，不是简单罗列差异。

inputs.name: candidate_opportunity_ids
inputs.description: 用户指定的待比较机会标识，可引用已有机会清单中的对象

inputs.name: verified_opportunity_list
inputs.description: 用户已经确认的真实机会清单，用于按标识取出待比较机会的完整信息

inputs.name: opportunity_pursuit_ranking
inputs.description: 用户已确认的机会投递优先顺序，用于与本次比较结果互相印证

inputs.name: user_profile
inputs.description: 用户已有的画像信息，用于判断每个候选机会与用户的匹配程度

inputs.name: comparison_criteria
inputs.description: 用户重视的维度，例如现阶段价值、时间成本、接触难度、与目标方向的一致性等

outputs.name: opportunity_comparison_result
outputs.description: 按用户标准比较候选机会，给出优先建议、理由和权衡说明

proposed_tasks.name: 帮我比较这几个内推渠道和人，看先重点经营哪个
proposed_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 人脉渠道比较
proposed_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望把自己指定的几个公开入口、内推渠道或联系人按自己关心的标准比较，得到现阶段最值得先重点接触哪个的建议和理由。
user_request_examples: 这几个内推渠道先经营哪个比较好？
帮我比较一下这几个联系人，看先联系谁更值得
这些公开入口里，哪个最值得我先花时间？
帮我把手上的几条人脉线索按价值排个先后
proposed_tasks.decision_reason: 需要把公开线索、熟人线索、用户背景和接触规则放在一起权衡并给出优先建议及理由，是决策型综合判断。

inputs.name: referral_entry_lead_list
inputs.description: 用户已有产物，是按机会整理的公开入口、渠道和联系人线索清单

inputs.name: matched_network_lead_list
inputs.description: 用户已有产物，是从现有联系人中筛出的可接触内推线索清单

inputs.name: user_profile
inputs.description: 用户已有的画像信息，用于判断候选线索与用户真实背景的相关程度

inputs.name: user_contact_rules
inputs.description: 用户对接触方式、不想打扰对象、渠道排除项和频率上限的说明

inputs.name: comparison_criteria
inputs.description: 用户重视的维度，例如接触难度、回复可能、长期价值、时间成本等

outputs.name: outreach_lead_comparison_result
outputs.description: 按用户标准比较候选内推渠道和联系人，给出优先接触建议、理由和权衡说明

retained_tasks.name: 帮我找这些机会的公开内推入口和人脉线索
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 寻找公开接触入口
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望为已确认的真实机会找到可公开接触的内推入口、官方推荐渠道、活动或社区线索，并尽量附上来源和核验状态。
user_request_examples: 帮我找找这些公司的内推入口和官方推荐渠道
我想看看这些机会有没有公开的校友或员工可以联系
帮我把每个机会的申请入口和人脉线索整理一下
找个能接触到这些团队的方式，最好有公开链接
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要把多个机会分别映射到公开渠道并去重、标注来源和可信度，是跨来源的综合判断，不是简单抓取。

inputs.description: 用户已经确认的真实机会清单，作为寻找内推入口和人脉线索的目标对象

inputs.name: user_profile
inputs.description: 用户已有的画像信息，用于匹配与用户背景相关的公开线索和判断适用渠道

inputs.name: search_result_web
inputs.description: 公开网络检索到的机会对应公司或机构的内推、招聘、活动或联系人线索，需带来源

inputs.name: user_preferred_channels
inputs.description: 用户愿意使用的平台和渠道范围，例如官方网站、公开社区、职业社交平台等

outputs.name: referral_entry_lead_list
outputs.display_name: 公开人脉入口线索清单
outputs.description: 按机会整理的内推入口、公开渠道、活动线索和可能联系人，含来源与核验状态

retained_tasks.name: 帮我看看我现有联系人里有没有能帮上忙的人
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 个人关系筛选
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望从自己明确提供的关系名单中，筛选出与目标机会相关、可以自然联系的人，并说明关系来源和适合的开口方式。
user_request_examples: 帮我看看我认识的人里有谁能帮我内推
我把联系人导出来了，帮我筛一下哪些跟我的目标机会相关
我有哪些熟人可能认识这些团队的人？
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要将非结构化的关系名单与机会清单做语义匹配、去重并判断是否构成可用的内推线索，是判断型转换。

inputs.name: user_contact_list

inputs.name: user_contact_rules

outputs.name: matched_network_lead_list

retained_tasks.name: 帮我核实这些内推线索和人脉信息靠不靠谱
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 线索核验
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望验证联系人、内推渠道或职位关系是否可公开核验、是否仍然相关，以及能否合法接触，并识别可能过时或不可信的线索。
user_request_examples: 帮我看下这个所谓的内推人是不是真的在这家公司
这个人脉线索靠谱吗？帮我核实一下公开信息
这些联系渠道有没有风险，哪些不能碰？
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要根据公开来源判断真实性和接触风险并形成分级结论，是关键判断而非简单查询。

inputs.name: lead_candidates
inputs.description: 用户提供或从其他途径得到的联系人、内推渠道线索，必须含可公开核验的姓名、组织、链接或其他标识

inputs.name: search_result_web
inputs.description: 公开网络检索到的与线索相关的职业信息、组织信息和关联证据

inputs.name: page_content
inputs.description: 被检视的具体页面或主页内容，用于核验联系人职业身份和关系真实性

inputs.name: user_contact_rules
inputs.description: 用户对联系方式的限制和风险容忍度，以及哪些渠道被明确排除

outputs.name: network_lead_verification_report
outputs.description: 逐条线索的可核验性、真实程度、相关性、接触风险和证据来源分级报告

retained_tasks.name: 帮我写一段自然、克制的联系消息
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 联系消息准备
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望在联系前获得一段说明真实来意、双方关系和可回应内容的草稿，不夸大关系、不虚构背书、不越权索求，并保持克制。
user_request_examples: 帮我写一段联系校友的消息，说明我在申请这个岗位
帮我写个私信草稿，问问对方能不能给点建议
我想联系这个人但不知道怎么说，帮我起草一版
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要把真实关系和机会信息转化为合宜的对话草稿，把握分寸并避免虚构，是内容决策而非模板调用。

inputs.name: contact_context
inputs.description: 对方称呼、关系类型、真实共同点或交集、公开联系方式以及拟使用的场合说明

inputs.name: verified_opportunity_list
inputs.description: 用户已经确认的真实机会清单，用于在消息中准确说明申请目标

inputs.name: tailored_application_packages

inputs.name: user_profile

inputs.name: message_preferences
inputs.description: 用户对语气、长度、渠道语言风格、称谓以及希望避免的措辞的偏好

outputs.name: contact_message_drafts
outputs.description: 针对不同场景和语气生成的自然、克制、可进一步编辑的联系消息草稿

retained_tasks.name: 帮我记录投递、回复和跟进状态
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 状态记录
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望把每次投递、回复、面试、跟进或关闭的动作整理成结构化记录，区分尚未投递、已投递、等待回复、需要跟进、进入面试和已结束，并保留来源、时间和下一步动作。
user_request_examples: 帮我记一下我今天投了这个岗位
这个公司回我了，约了周三面试，帮我更新一下
我上个月投的还没消息，帮我记下该跟进了
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要把杂乱的用户动作归类到明确状态机并计算下一步动作，属于语义判断而非单纯存储。

inputs.name: status_update_events
inputs.description: 用户口述或粘贴的投递、回复、面试、跟进、关闭事件，时间和来源由用户提供

inputs.name: current_tracking_records
inputs.description: 用户已有的追踪记录，可为空，用于增量更新而不是覆盖

inputs.name: verified_opportunity_list
inputs.description: 用户已经确认的真实机会清单，用于关联每一条状态记录到正确机会

inputs.name: user_followup_cadence
inputs.description: 用户希望多久跟进一次、用什么方式跟进，具体节奏由用户提供

outputs.name: application_tracking_ledger
outputs.description: 按机会聚合的状态记录，含最新状态、来源、更新时间、下一步动作和提醒依据

retained_tasks.name: 帮我整理投递情况，告诉下一步该跟进谁
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 跟进优先级
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望基于当前追踪记录和机会优先级，得到一份按紧迫度和价值排序的跟进清单，包括具体动作、渠道和时限。
user_request_examples: 帮我看看我最该跟进哪个机会
把这周该跟进的整理一下
哪些还没投、哪些该等、哪些该催一催？
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 综合状态、机会优先级、用户时间偏好计算谁先谁后和具体做什么，是决策型转化。

inputs.name: opportunity_pursuit_ranking

inputs.name: user_followup_preferences

inputs.name: user_available_time

outputs.name: prioritized_followup_plan

retained_tasks.name: 帮我了解待联系的人平时做什么、团队怎么协作、看重什么
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 联系前了解
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望在联系前了解目标机会中相关人员的日常职责、工作场景、协作方式和入门要求，以便问对问题、展示真实兴趣。
user_request_examples: 帮我看下这个岗位的团队平时做什么
我想知道联系这个人时该了解哪些他的工作内容
这个公司要求的经验到底是什么样的？
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 需要从不同公开资料中提炼出可实际用于对话的人物与工作情境理解，是综合归纳而非检索包装。

inputs.name: user_profile

retained_tasks.name: 帮我对照这些机会的要求，看看我还有哪些差距、补什么证据
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 差距与证据准备
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望把自己的真实经历和材料与目标机会的要求逐项对照，找出差距，并准备在联系和申请中能说明的补充证据，而不是编造。

我该怎么证明我适合这个方向？
这些岗位要求的经验，我有哪些可以拿出来说？
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 把机会要求拆解、与个人真实证据映射并判定差距，属于判断型综合分析。

retained_tasks.name: 帮我制定接下来一段时间的跟进和拓展行动计划
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 近期行动规划
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望把找入口、核验、联系、投递、跟进等动作排进一个可执行的近期计划，并根据自己可投入的时间和偏好设检查点。
user_request_examples: 帮我安排接下来几周的人脉跟进计划
我每周只有一点时间，帮我排一下先做什么
帮我做个计划，什么时候联系谁、什么时候跟进
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 把多个异步动作按用户约束编排成有序计划并设检查点，是计划型决策。

retained_tasks.name: 帮我排一下接下来先联系谁、后联系谁
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 联系前排序
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望把已经找到的公开入口和熟人线索，按机会的重要程度和自己的时间限制排成一个先后顺序，并说明先联系的理由和每步做什么。
user_request_examples: 帮我排一下这几个入口先联系哪个
我手上线索有点多，帮我定个先后顺序
这些熟人和公开渠道先经营哪个比较好？
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 把多条不同性质的线索按机会优先级、用户规则和时间预算排出先后并给理由，是跨线索的综合排序判断，不是简单罗列。

retained_tasks.name: 帮我把要发出去的消息再过一遍，标出不合适的地方
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 发送前检查
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望把已经写好的联系消息草稿逐条检查，标出可能让人不舒服、越界、夸大关系、泄露隐私或语气不当的地方，并给出改法，确认后再发送。
user_request_examples: 我准备发这条消息了，帮我看看有没有不妥
帮我把这几版消息检查一下，哪句容易被误会
这条私信会不会显得太冒昧？帮我标出来
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 把内容草稿与用户边界和核验事实逐句对照，标出风险并给改写建议，是内容品质判断而不是格式检查。

retained_tasks.name: 帮我整理一下目前收到的所有回复，告诉我每件事该做什么
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 回复汇总
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望把所有岗位和联系人发来的回复、面试邀约、婉拒、待办整理成一份清楚的总览，按紧急程度列出每件事的下一步和截止时间。
user_request_examples: 帮我把最近收到的回复整理一下
哪些需要我回、哪些约了面试，帮我列清楚
我收到好几个消息，帮我看看现在最该处理什么
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 把分散在多个机会和联系人上的回复状态归并成按紧急度排序的行动总览，并标出每项截止时间，是综合判断而非简单抄录。

retained_tasks.name: 帮我准备一下和这个人见面聊什么、怎么开口
retained_tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 信息交流准备
retained_tasks.business_goal: 用户希望为一次即将进行的信息交流准备一张谈话准备单，包括对方的工作背景、可以问的问题、可以先说的话和结束时的表达，保证每句都基于真实资料。
user_request_examples: 我约了和这位聊一下，帮我想想要问什么
帮我准备一下这次交流的开场和结束语
跟这个人聊之前，帮我梳理下可以谈什么
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 把已经核实过的对方信息和用户背景转成具体的谈话材料，一次只给真正可聊的话题和自然的说法，是内容组织判断。

retained_tasks.name: 帮我把接下来的计划拆成这一周能做的事

user_request_examples: 帮我把计划拆成这周要做的清单
这周我只有一些零散时间，帮我排下能做什么
接下来这周具体做哪几件事？列个清单给我
retained_tasks.decision_reason: 把一段时期的计划剪裁成一周内可勾选的小事项，并照顾每周时间余量，是计划和执行的转译判断。

input.system_prompt:
You are a SkillTool portfolio architect. Design reusable, standalone AI capabilities from a reference profile and a reference business scenario. These inputs may be free-form natural language; do not assume they follow a JSON schema. A SkillTool is a bounded business capability executed by a child model through an external API. It must not depend on an application implementation.

Rules:
1. Return strict JSON only. Never wrap JSON in Markdown. Never use ellipses (`...`), comments, pseudo-JSON, or placeholder literals; represent illustrative context as ordinary strings so the entire response parses with a standard JSON parser.
2. Preserve uncertainty and evidence provenance. Do not invent personal facts or live market facts.
3. Design a menu of independently invocable capabilities for a scenario, not a mandatory end-to-end workflow. Parallel capabilities are the default; composition is optional.
4. Build an explicit input inventory before designing capabilities. Reuse contracted upstream artifacts even when their producer was an ordinary tool and therefore was not synthesized as a SkillTool.
5. Every task input must use exactly one truthful provisioning class: user-provided input, an existing ordinary-tool output, an existing scenario artifact, or a prior task output. Every input and output declares a concrete JSON type.
6. Every output must have an explicit schema and at least one truthful consumer. The user or an external system is a valid consumer; never invent a downstream SkillTool merely to create a chain.
7. A SkillTool owns one meaningful business decision or transformation. Reject trivial formatting/retrieval wrappers and split multi-decision mega-skills. Tasks already handled by an ordinary tool remain visible as input producers but must not become SkillTools.
8. SkillTools are portable: no main-program imports, database assumptions, UI state, route names, or internal service calls.
9. Profile and scenario are strictly decoupled. The scenario defines the problem space. The profile only supplies personal evidence and constraints inside that space. Never infer a target industry, role, or scenario domain from education, major, projects, or skills.
10. If the scenario domain is open, keep exploration cross-domain or request an explicit domain; never silently default to the profile's background.
11. Auxiliary tools may only come from the supplied non-Skill tool catalog. Select none by default. Every selected tool needs a required, optional, or conditional usage mode and a concrete reason. Conditional tools need a condition; optional tools need a fallback.
12. Never select Skill, discover_skills, ReturnSkillResult, a generated SkillActionTool, or another recursive Skill entry as an auxiliary tool.
13. Use snake_case IDs and PascalCase tool names.
14. A standalone SkillTool must be runnable from provided inputs, upstream artifacts, user input, or ordinary tools. Prior SkillTool outputs may enrich it only as optional inputs.
15. Only an explicitly aggregate capability may require prior SkillTool outputs, and aggregate capabilities must remain a minority of the portfolio.

Discover the next batch of modular tasks through iterative synthesis.

ITERATION: 3
ITERATION DIRECTION: decomposition

REFERENCE PROFILE (personal evidence and constraints only):
用户是一名计算机科学与技术硕士研究生，预计 12 至 18 个月后毕业，目前没有正式实习经历。求职地点优先考虑上海、杭州和深圳，每周可投入 8 至 12 小时进行方向探索。

已有证据包括：用 Python 和 PyTorch 完成课程及研究实验；独立完成过图像分类课程项目和校园知识库问答原型；能够检索论文、设计对比实验并撰写技术报告。尚无生产部署、多人协作、真实用户、业务指标或正式开发流程方面的可靠证据，商业问题理解能力也尚未验证。

用户喜欢分析复杂问题、做实验或设计方案，希望成果能被真实采用并获得明确反馈；不喜欢长期重复且缺少判断空间的工作。倾向先比较多个方向，再通过真实岗位、信息访谈、短期项目或实习投递验证。

画像只提供个人事实、证据、偏好和现实约束。不得因为计算机专业、Python、PyTorch 或问答原型，直接推断用户的目标行业、目标岗位或目标赛道。

REFERENCE SCENARIO (scope and boundary only):
本轮场景是“人脉申请追踪”。这是一个面向不同自然用户的通用场景，不预设城市、学校、专业、技术栈、行业、岗位、公司、联系人或申请渠道。

上一场景是“岗位材料准备”，已经产生并由用户确认已有产物 `user_profile`（用户画像，object 类型）、已有产物 `verified_opportunity_list`（真实岗位机会清单，array 类型）、已有产物 `opportunity_pursuit_ranking`（岗位投递优先顺序，array 类型）、已有产物 `tailored_application_packages`（针对岗位准备的投递材料，array 类型）和已有产物 `material_quality_report`（投递材料检查结果，object 类型）。本轮可以读取这些产物，但不得重新生成或修改用户画像、岗位事实和投递材料。

用户希望寻找合适的公开人脉入口和内推线索，准备自然、克制的联系话术，并持续记录每个岗位的投递、回复、面试、跟进和关闭状态。用户已经投递过哪些岗位、认识哪些人、愿意使用哪些渠道、何时投递以及希望多久跟进，都应在调用时获取，不能在场景或任务中写死。

联系人信息只能来自用户明确提供的关系或可公开核验的职业信息，不得猜测私人联系方式、绕过平台权限或批量骚扰。联系话术应说明真实来意和双方关系，不虚构共同经历、熟人背书或已获得推荐。任何实际发送、投递、撤回或修改外部系统状态的动作，都必须在执行前让用户确认目标、内容和范围；本场景默认只生成草稿、清单和下一步提醒。

任务输入只能来自四类：调用时向用户获取的输入、现有普通工具生成的输出、场景声明的已有产物、第二轮及以后已经存在的任务输出。每个输入和输出必须声明 object、array、string、number 或 boolean 类型。MCP 工具不在本场景范围内。

合成出的任务必须像普通用户会直接提出的一条完整请求。例如“帮我找找这些公司的内推入口”“帮我写一段联系校友的消息”“把我最近投过的岗位整理一下并告诉我下一步该跟进谁”，不要使用流程分析、可验证闭环或证据矩阵等专业化表达。追踪结果应清楚区分尚未投递、已投递、等待回复、需要跟进、进入面试和已结束，并为每项记录保留来源、更新时间和下一步动作。

DIRECTION RULE: DECOMPOSITION REPLACEMENT ONLY. Inspect RETAINED TASKS for a task that is too broad or bundles multiple independently useful user outcomes. Replace that parent with at least two smaller tasks; the parent will be removed from the active pool. Every child must still be something a normal user would ask directly, must have a narrower outcome, must set evolution_direction to decomposition, and must name exactly one shared parent task ID in source_task_ids. Do not decompose a parent whose output is already consumed by another retained task, because removing it would break the input/output flow. Do not expose implementation steps such as extraction, mapping, scoring, or formatting as tasks. Return an empty tasks array when no safe, natural replacement is justified.
TASK COUNT RULE: Return 0-8 new tasks; an empty array is valid when no justified task exists.

      ],

USER-EXPRESSIBILITY GATE:
- A task is a user-recognizable request, not an internal analysis step, ontology operation, or pipeline component.
- Start from what a normal user would ask for in one message. Use everyday service language such as “帮我看看我适合哪些方向”, “帮我比较这几个岗位”, or “我接下来四周先做什么”.
- Do not expose abstract implementation labels as tasks, including “映射”, “矩阵构建”, “假设生成”, “提取”, “模式分析”, “方向模式”, “建模”, “聚类”, “框架设计”, or “优先级计算”, unless that exact technical artifact is explicitly requested by the user. These may be internal workflow steps inside a broader user-facing task.
- Run the utterance test before returning each task: if its `name` and `business_goal` cannot naturally complete “我想请你……” or “帮我……”, rewrite, merge into a user-facing outcome, or remove it.
- `user_request_examples` is mandatory and must contain 2-4 distinct, realistic utterances without analyst jargon. It is evidence that the task passes the utterance test; do not merely paraphrase an abstract task label.
- For extension tasks, run the continuation test: every example must sound natural after “那接下来……”. Rewrite phrases such as “形成可验证假设”, “建立证据闭环”, or “输出置信度评估” into the concrete thing the user wants to compare, choose, check, prepare, or schedule.
- Prefer the smallest set that still satisfies the direction's explicit coverage and count rule. Never create analytical subtasks merely to increase the count. Keep inputs and outputs structured internally, but keep the task boundary and visible wording natural.

GENERALITY AND PARAMETERIZATION GATE:
- The scenario defines a reusable capability for many users. The reference profile is only one sample used to select relevant capabilities; none of its literal facts may become fixed task scope.
- Do not copy cities, regions, employers, schools, degrees, majors, technologies, personal projects, dates, numeric targets, time budgets, or other sample-user values into any task field, including input names and descriptions.
- Do not generalize a sample computer-science profile into “技术岗位”, “技术方向”, “算法”, “软件”, “开发”, or similar domain language. Use domain-neutral terms such as “目标岗位类型”, “目标方向”, and “用户指定领域”.
- Keep variable details as typed invocation inputs. Say “目标地区”, “用户指定的机会类型”, “希望保留的方向数量”, and “可用验证周期” rather than inserting sample values.
- A generic job-search task should be “帮我寻找符合我条件的真实岗位机会”, never “帮我寻找某几个具体城市的某类岗位”. A generic planning task must not hard-code a four-week duration or a fixed number of directions.
- Before returning, compare every user-visible task field against REFERENCE PROFILE and remove or parameterize any copied personal detail.

Follow TASK COUNT RULE exactly. In initialization, `coverage` must contain at least 8 distinct scenario outcomes and every proposed task ID must appear in at least one `covered_by` list. Every proposed task must predict at least one concrete output before it can be retained. Input descriptions and output `dedupe_key` values must describe stable semantics rather than wording so input, output, and task-description similarity can all be checked. Enforce the source/origin pairs exactly: user_input/user_provided, ordinary_tool_output/tool_generated, upstream_artifact/existing_artifact, prior_output/prior_task_output. User input may be inferred when it is reasonable to ask at invocation time. A tool-generated input must name an exact AVAILABLE ORDINARY TOOLS provider. An existing-artifact input must reference an asset_id from EXISTING SCENARIO ARTIFACTS. A prior-task-output input must reference TASK OUTPUT POOL and is forbidden in iteration 1. Every input and output must declare type; every output must use output_origin task_generated. Mark simple collection, CRUD, retrieval, and profile persistence tasks ordinary_tool or input_only; synthesize only non-trivial reusable decisions or transformations. Stay inside the reference scenario. Treat the task map as a user-facing capability menu, not an execution plan. A technical profile must not turn a generic scenario into a technology-specific scenario.

messages.content:
You are a SkillTool portfolio architect. Design reusable, standalone AI capabilities from a reference profile and a reference business scenario. These inputs may be free-form natural language; do not assume they follow a JSON schema. A SkillTool is a bounded business capability executed by a child model through an external API. It must not depend on an application implementation.

Rules:
1. Return strict JSON only. Never wrap JSON in Markdown. Never use ellipses (`...`), comments, pseudo-JSON, or placeholder literals; represent illustrative context as ordinary strings so the entire response parses with a standard JSON parser.
2. Preserve uncertainty and evidence provenance. Do not invent personal facts or live market facts.
3. Design a menu of independently invocable capabilities for a scenario, not a mandatory end-to-end workflow. Parallel capabilities are the default; composition is optional.
4. Build an explicit input inventory before designing capabilities. Reuse contracted upstream artifacts even when their producer was an ordinary tool and therefore was not synthesized as a SkillTool.
5. Every task input must use exactly one truthful provisioning class: user-provided input, an existing ordinary-tool output, an existing scenario artifact, or a prior task output. Every input and output declares a concrete JSON type.
6. Every output must have an explicit schema and at least one truthful consumer. The user or an external system is a valid consumer; never invent a downstream SkillTool merely to create a chain.
7. A SkillTool owns one meaningful business decision or transformation. Reject trivial formatting/retrieval wrappers and split multi-decision mega-skills. Tasks already handled by an ordinary tool remain visible as input producers but must not become SkillTools.
8. SkillTools are portable: no main-program imports, database assumptions, UI state, route names, or internal service calls.
9. Profile and scenario are strictly decoupled. The scenario defines the problem space. The profile only supplies personal evidence and constraints inside that space. Never infer a target industry, role, or scenario domain from education, major, projects, or skills.
10. If the scenario domain is open, keep exploration cross-domain or request an explicit domain; never silently default to the profile's background.
11. Auxiliary tools may only come from the supplied non-Skill tool catalog. Select none by default. Every selected tool needs a required, optional, or conditional usage mode and a concrete reason. Conditional tools need a condition; optional tools need a fallback.
12. Never select Skill, discover_skills, ReturnSkillResult, a generated SkillActionTool, or another recursive Skill entry as an auxiliary tool.
13. Use snake_case IDs and PascalCase tool names.
14. A standalone SkillTool must be runnable from provided inputs, upstream artifacts, user input, or ordinary tools. Prior SkillTool outputs may enrich it only as optional inputs.
15. Only an explicitly aggregate capability may require prior SkillTool outputs, and aggregate capabilities must remain a minority of the portfolio.

Discover the next batch of modular tasks through iterative synthesis.

ITERATION: 3
ITERATION DIRECTION: decomposition

REFERENCE PROFILE (personal evidence and constraints only):
用户是一名计算机科学与技术硕士研究生，预计 12 至 18 个月后毕业，目前没有正式实习经历。求职地点优先考虑上海、杭州和深圳，每周可投入 8 至 12 小时进行方向探索。

已有证据包括：用 Python 和 PyTorch 完成课程及研究实验；独立完成过图像分类课程项目和校园知识库问答原型；能够检索论文、设计对比实验并撰写技术报告。尚无生产部署、多人协作、真实用户、业务指标或正式开发流程方面的可靠证据，商业问题理解能力也尚未验证。

用户喜欢分析复杂问题、做实验或设计方案，希望成果能被真实采用并获得明确反馈；不喜欢长期重复且缺少判断空间的工作。倾向先比较多个方向，再通过真实岗位、信息访谈、短期项目或实习投递验证。

画像只提供个人事实、证据、偏好和现实约束。不得因为计算机专业、Python、PyTorch 或问答原型，直接推断用户的目标行业、目标岗位或目标赛道。

REFERENCE SCENARIO (scope and boundary only):
本轮场景是“人脉申请追踪”。这是一个面向不同自然用户的通用场景，不预设城市、学校、专业、技术栈、行业、岗位、公司、联系人或申请渠道。

上一场景是“岗位材料准备”，已经产生并由用户确认已有产物 `user_profile`（用户画像，object 类型）、已有产物 `verified_opportunity_list`（真实岗位机会清单，array 类型）、已有产物 `opportunity_pursuit_ranking`（岗位投递优先顺序，array 类型）、已有产物 `tailored_application_packages`（针对岗位准备的投递材料，array 类型）和已有产物 `material_quality_report`（投递材料检查结果，object 类型）。本轮可以读取这些产物，但不得重新生成或修改用户画像、岗位事实和投递材料。

用户希望寻找合适的公开人脉入口和内推线索，准备自然、克制的联系话术，并持续记录每个岗位的投递、回复、面试、跟进和关闭状态。用户已经投递过哪些岗位、认识哪些人、愿意使用哪些渠道、何时投递以及希望多久跟进，都应在调用时获取，不能在场景或任务中写死。

联系人信息只能来自用户明确提供的关系或可公开核验的职业信息，不得猜测私人联系方式、绕过平台权限或批量骚扰。联系话术应说明真实来意和双方关系，不虚构共同经历、熟人背书或已获得推荐。任何实际发送、投递、撤回或修改外部系统状态的动作，都必须在执行前让用户确认目标、内容和范围；本场景默认只生成草稿、清单和下一步提醒。

任务输入只能来自四类：调用时向用户获取的输入、现有普通工具生成的输出、场景声明的已有产物、第二轮及以后已经存在的任务输出。每个输入和输出必须声明 object、array、string、number 或 boolean 类型。MCP 工具不在本场景范围内。

合成出的任务必须像普通用户会直接提出的一条完整请求。例如“帮我找找这些公司的内推入口”“帮我写一段联系校友的消息”“把我最近投过的岗位整理一下并告诉我下一步该跟进谁”，不要使用流程分析、可验证闭环或证据矩阵等专业化表达。追踪结果应清楚区分尚未投递、已投递、等待回复、需要跟进、进入面试和已结束，并为每项记录保留来源、更新时间和下一步动作。

input.system_prompt:
You are a SkillTool portfolio architect. Design reusable, standalone AI capabilities from a reference profile and a reference business scenario. These inputs may be free-form natural language; do not assume they follow a JSON schema. A SkillTool is a bounded business capability executed by a child model through an external API. It must not depend on an application implementation.

Rules:
1. Return strict JSON only. Never wrap JSON in Markdown. Never use ellipses (`...`), comments, pseudo-JSON, or placeholder literals; represent illustrative context as ordinary strings so the entire response parses with a standard JSON parser.
2. Preserve uncertainty and evidence provenance. Do not invent personal facts or live market facts.
3. Design a menu of independently invocable capabilities for a scenario, not a mandatory end-to-end workflow. Parallel capabilities are the default; composition is optional.
4. Build an explicit input inventory before designing capabilities. Reuse contracted upstream artifacts even when their producer was an ordinary tool and therefore was not synthesized as a SkillTool.
5. Every task input must use exactly one truthful provisioning class: user-provided input, an existing ordinary-tool output, an existing scenario artifact, or a prior task output. Every input and output declares a concrete JSON type.
6. Every output must have an explicit schema and at least one truthful consumer. The user or an external system is a valid consumer; never invent a downstream SkillTool merely to create a chain.
7. A SkillTool owns one meaningful business decision or transformation. Reject trivial formatting/retrieval wrappers and split multi-decision mega-skills. Tasks already handled by an ordinary tool remain visible as input producers but must not become SkillTools.
8. SkillTools are portable: no main-program imports, database assumptions, UI state, route names, or internal service calls.
9. Profile and scenario are strictly decoupled. The scenario defines the problem space. The profile only supplies personal evidence and constraints inside that space. Never infer a target industry, role, or scenario domain from education, major, projects, or skills.
10. If the scenario domain is open, keep exploration cross-domain or request an explicit domain; never silently default to the profile's background.
11. Auxiliary tools may only come from the supplied non-Skill tool catalog. Select none by default. Every selected tool needs a required, optional, or conditional usage mode and a concrete reason. Conditional tools need a condition; optional tools need a fallback.
12. Never select Skill, discover_skills, ReturnSkillResult, a generated SkillActionTool, or another recursive Skill entry as an auxiliary tool.
13. Use snake_case IDs and PascalCase tool names.
14. A standalone SkillTool must be runnable from provided inputs, upstream artifacts, user input, or ordinary tools. Prior SkillTool outputs may enrich it only as optional inputs.
15. Only an explicitly aggregate capability may require prior SkillTool outputs, and aggregate capabilities must remain a minority of the portfolio.

Discover the next batch of modular tasks through iterative synthesis.

REFERENCE PROFILE (personal evidence and constraints only):
用户是一名计算机科学与技术硕士研究生，预计 12 至 18 个月后毕业，目前没有正式实习经历。求职地点优先考虑上海、杭州和深圳，每周可投入 8 至 12 小时进行方向探索。

已有证据包括：用 Python 和 PyTorch 完成课程及研究实验；独立完成过图像分类课程项目和校园知识库问答原型；能够检索论文、设计对比实验并撰写技术报告。尚无生产部署、多人协作、真实用户、业务指标或正式开发流程方面的可靠证据，商业问题理解能力也尚未验证。

用户喜欢分析复杂问题、做实验或设计方案，希望成果能被真实采用并获得明确反馈；不喜欢长期重复且缺少判断空间的工作。倾向先比较多个方向，再通过真实岗位、信息访谈、短期项目或实习投递验证。

画像只提供个人事实、证据、偏好和现实约束。不得因为计算机专业、Python、PyTorch 或问答原型，直接推断用户的目标行业、目标岗位或目标赛道。

REFERENCE SCENARIO (scope and boundary only):
本轮场景是“人脉申请追踪”。这是一个面向不同自然用户的通用场景，不预设城市、学校、专业、技术栈、行业、岗位、公司、联系人或申请渠道。

上一场景是“岗位材料准备”，已经产生并由用户确认已有产物 `user_profile`（用户画像，object 类型）、已有产物 `verified_opportunity_list`（真实岗位机会清单，array 类型）、已有产物 `opportunity_pursuit_ranking`（岗位投递优先顺序，array 类型）、已有产物 `tailored_application_packages`（针对岗位准备的投递材料，array 类型）和已有产物 `material_quality_report`（投递材料检查结果，object 类型）。本轮可以读取这些产物，但不得重新生成或修改用户画像、岗位事实和投递材料。

用户希望寻找合适的公开人脉入口和内推线索，准备自然、克制的联系话术，并持续记录每个岗位的投递、回复、面试、跟进和关闭状态。用户已经投递过哪些岗位、认识哪些人、愿意使用哪些渠道、何时投递以及希望多久跟进，都应在调用时获取，不能在场景或任务中写死。

联系人信息只能来自用户明确提供的关系或可公开核验的职业信息，不得猜测私人联系方式、绕过平台权限或批量骚扰。联系话术应说明真实来意和双方关系，不虚构共同经历、熟人背书或已获得推荐。任何实际发送、投递、撤回或修改外部系统状态的动作，都必须在执行前让用户确认目标、内容和范围；本场景默认只生成草稿、清单和下一步提醒。

任务输入只能来自四类：调用时向用户获取的输入、现有普通工具生成的输出、场景声明的已有产物、第二轮及以后已经存在的任务输出。每个输入和输出必须声明 object、array、string、number 或 boolean 类型。MCP 工具不在本场景范围内。

合成出的任务必须像普通用户会直接提出的一条完整请求。例如“帮我找找这些公司的内推入口”“帮我写一段联系校友的消息”“把我最近投过的岗位整理一下并告诉我下一步该跟进谁”，不要使用流程分析、可验证闭环或证据矩阵等专业化表达。追踪结果应清楚区分尚未投递、已投递、等待回复、需要跟进、进入面试和已结束，并为每项记录保留来源、更新时间和下一步动作。

USER-EXPRESSIBILITY GATE:
- A task is a user-recognizable request, not an internal analysis step, ontology operation, or pipeline component.
- Start from what a normal user would ask for in one message. Use everyday service language such as “帮我看看我适合哪些方向”, “帮我比较这几个岗位”, or “我接下来四周先做什么”.
- Do not expose abstract implementation labels as tasks, including “映射”, “矩阵构建”, “假设生成”, “提取”, “模式分析”, “方向模式”, “建模”, “聚类”, “框架设计”, or “优先级计算”, unless that exact technical artifact is explicitly requested by the user. These may be internal workflow steps inside a broader user-facing task.
- Run the utterance test before returning each task: if its `name` and `business_goal` cannot naturally complete “我想请你……” or “帮我……”, rewrite, merge into a user-facing outcome, or remove it.
- `user_request_examples` is mandatory and must contain 2-4 distinct, realistic utterances without analyst jargon. It is evidence that the task passes the utterance test; do not merely paraphrase an abstract task label.
- For extension tasks, run the continuation test: every example must sound natural after “那接下来……”. Rewrite phrases such as “形成可验证假设”, “建立证据闭环”, or “输出置信度评估” into the concrete thing the user wants to compare, choose, check, prepare, or schedule.

GENERALITY AND PARAMETERIZATION GATE:
- The scenario defines a reusable capability for many users. The reference profile is only one sample used to select relevant capabilities; none of its literal facts may become fixed task scope.
- Do not copy cities, regions, employers, schools, degrees, majors, technologies, personal projects, dates, numeric targets, time budgets, or other sample-user values into any task field, including input names and descriptions.
- Do not generalize a sample computer-science profile into “技术岗位”, “技术方向”, “算法”, “软件”, “开发”, or similar domain language. Use domain-neutral terms such as “目标岗位类型”, “目标方向”, and “用户指定领域”.
- Keep variable details as typed invocation inputs. Say “目标地区”, “用户指定的机会类型”, “希望保留的方向数量”, and “可用验证周期” rather than inserting sample values.
- A generic job-search task should be “帮我寻找符合我条件的真实岗位机会”, never “帮我寻找某几个具体城市的某类岗位”. A generic planning task must not hard-code a four-week duration or a fixed number of directions.

Every proposed task must predict at least one concrete output before it can be retained. Input descriptions and output `dedupe_key` values must describe stable semantics rather than wording so input, output, and task-description similarity can all be checked. Enforce the source/origin pairs exactly: user_input/user_provided, ordinary_tool_output/tool_generated, upstream_artifact/existing_artifact, prior_output/prior_task_output. User input may be inferred when it is reasonable to ask at invocation time. A tool-generated input must name an exact AVAILABLE ORDINARY TOOLS provider. An existing-artifact input must reference an asset_id from EXISTING SCENARIO ARTIFACTS. A prior-task-output input must reference TASK OUTPUT POOL and is forbidden in iteration 1. Every input and output must declare type; every output must use output_origin task_generated. Mark simple collection, CRUD, retrieval, and profile persistence tasks ordinary_tool or input_only; synthesize only non-trivial reusable decisions or transformations. Stay inside the reference scenario. Treat the task map as a user-facing capability menu, not an execution plan. A technical profile must not turn a generic scenario into a technology-specific scenario.

messages.content:
You are a SkillTool portfolio architect. Design reusable, standalone AI capabilities from a reference profile and a reference business scenario. These inputs may be free-form natural language; do not assume they follow a JSON schema. A SkillTool is a bounded business capability executed by a child model through an external API. It must not depend on an application implementation.

Rules:
1. Return strict JSON only. Never wrap JSON in Markdown. Never use ellipses (`...`), comments, pseudo-JSON, or placeholder literals; represent illustrative context as ordinary strings so the entire response parses with a standard JSON parser.
2. Preserve uncertainty and evidence provenance. Do not invent personal facts or live market facts.
3. Design a menu of independently invocable capabilities for a scenario, not a mandatory end-to-end workflow. Parallel capabilities are the default; composition is optional.
4. Build an explicit input inventory before designing capabilities. Reuse contracted upstream artifacts even when their producer was an ordinary tool and therefore was not synthesized as a SkillTool.
5. Every task input must use exactly one truthful provisioning class: user-provided input, an existing ordinary-tool output, an existing scenario artifact, or a prior task output. Every input and output declares a concrete JSON type.
6. Every output must have an explicit schema and at least one truthful consumer. The user or an external system is a valid consumer; never invent a downstream SkillTool merely to create a chain.
7. A SkillTool owns one meaningful business decision or transformation. Reject trivial formatting/retrieval wrappers and split multi-decision mega-skills. Tasks already handled by an ordinary tool remain visible as input producers but must not become SkillTools.
8. SkillTools are portable: no main-program imports, database assumptions, UI state, route names, or internal service calls.
9. Profile and scenario are strictly decoupled. The scenario defines the problem space. The profile only supplies personal evidence and constraints inside that space. Never infer a target industry, role, or scenario domain from education, major, projects, or skills.
10. If the scenario domain is open, keep exploration cross-domain or request an explicit domain; never silently default to the profile's background.
11. Auxiliary tools may only come from the supplied non-Skill tool catalog. Select none by default. Every selected tool needs a required, optional, or conditional usage mode and a concrete reason. Conditional tools need a condition; optional tools need a fallback.
12. Never select Skill, discover_skills, ReturnSkillResult, a generated SkillActionTool, or another recursive Skill entry as an auxiliary tool.

tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 机会比较
tasks.business_goal: 用户希望把自己指定的几个真实机会按自己关心的标准比较，得到现阶段最值得优先投递或重点准备的建议和理由。
user_request_examples: 帮我比较这几个岗位，看哪个最值得现在投
这几个机会里我想选一个重点准备，帮我比一比
我拿不定主意，帮我把这些岗位的条件列出来比一下
根据我的情况，这几个机会哪个优先级更高？
tasks.decision_reason: 需要把用户自选标准、机会事实、用户背景和既有投递优先级放在一起权衡并给出推荐理由，是决策型综合判断，不是简单罗列差异。

inputs.name: candidate_opportunity_ids
inputs.description: 用户指定的待比较机会标识，可引用已有机会清单中的对象

inputs.name: verified_opportunity_list
inputs.description: 用户已经确认的真实机会清单，用于按标识取出待比较机会的完整信息

inputs.name: opportunity_pursuit_ranking
inputs.description: 用户已确认的机会投递优先顺序，用于与本次比较结果互相印证

inputs.name: user_profile
inputs.description: 用户已有的画像信息，用于判断每个候选机会与用户的匹配程度

inputs.name: comparison_criteria
inputs.description: 用户重视的维度，例如现阶段价值、时间成本、接触难度、与目标方向的一致性等

outputs.name: opportunity_comparison_result
outputs.description: 按用户标准比较候选机会，给出优先建议、理由和权衡说明

tasks.name: 帮我比较这几个内推渠道和人，看先重点经营哪个
tasks.scene: 人脉申请追踪 - 人脉渠道比较
tasks.business_goal: 用户希望把自己指定的几个公开入口、内推渠道或联系人按自己关心的标准比较，得到现阶段最值得先重点接触哪个的建议和理由。
user_request_examples: 这几个内推渠道先经营哪个比较好？
帮我比较一下这几个联系人，看先联系谁更值得
这些公开入口里，哪个最值得我先花时间？
帮我把手上的几条人脉线索按价值排个先后
tasks.decision_reason: 需要把公开线索、熟人线索、用户背景和接触规则放在一起权衡并给出优先建议及理由，是决策型综合判断。

inputs.name: candidate_lead_ids
inputs.description: 用户指定的待比较人脉渠道或联系人标识，可引用已有线索清单中的对象

inputs.name: referral_entry_lead_list
inputs.description: 用户已有产物，是按机会整理的公开入口、渠道和联系人线索清单

inputs.name: matched_network_lead_list
inputs.description: 用户已有产物，是从现有联系人中筛出的可接触内推线索清单

inputs.name: user_profile
inputs.description: 用户已有的画像信息，用于判断候选线索与用户真实背景的相关程度

inputs.name: user_contact_rules
inputs.description: 用户对接触方式、不想打扰对象、渠道排除项和频率上限的说明

inputs.name: comparison_criteria
inputs.description: 用户重视的维度，例如接触难度、回复可能、长期价值、时间成本等

outputs.name: outreach_lead_comparison_result
outputs.description: 按用户标准比较候选内推渠道和联系人，给出优先接触建议、理由和权衡说明

iteration_control.reason: 已将一个同时覆盖机会比较和人脉渠道比较的宽任务拆成两个独立能力；仍可能存在其他同时覆盖多项独立结果的宽任务，可继续在后续迭代中检查。
